items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: We played at the—George and I played at the Banner Club for a long time.

ctx.x: Yeah, I see. He took that... The one off that's not fretted. Yeah, yeah. The one that's not fretted.

You just play the same note? Yeah. I got a friend of mine who plays the live part of one right now. A five string banjo. He's a guitar player too. He's from here? Yeah, he's a boy from here. He'll play at the... He'll play at the... at the Preservation Hall. He's a good guitar player. He's a guitar player like Sam. A good guitar player and a good banjo player. What's his name? I just forgot him. I ain't seen him in so long. Yeah. I forgot him. And he has a five string banjo? He's got a five string banjo. I met…
Yeah, I see. Come on. Do you have his address or phone number, Sam Hopkins? Do you have Sam Hopkins' phone number or address?
